definition: Contributions per account-year
rationale: Typical DAF accounts receive a few gifts a year; high case covers payroll/recurring givers.
validation_method: Replace with sponsor transaction extract (count per active fund).

definition: Grants per account-year
source: daf-landscape cost register CST-T13 uses 10 grants/account-year
rationale: Matches prior register base; high = active grantmakers.
validation_method: Sponsor grant ledger counts per fund.

definition: Journal lines per contribution (append-only double entry)
source: Unbound FULL-ACCOUNTING-SYSTEM ledger requirement (immutable posting, correction links); reasoning
rationale: Base: receipt (cash Dr / contribution revenue Cr) + fund-balance allocation (2 lines). High adds fee accrual, non-cash asset liquidation and a correction pair.
validation_method: Count lines produced by the ledger component for synthetic contribution scenarios.

definition: Journal lines per grant (recommendation to cleared payment)
source: reasoning from grant lifecycle (commit, pay, clear)
rationale: Commitment 2 + disbursement 2 + bank clearing 2. High adds void/reissue or correction pairs.
validation_method: Count lines for the grant lifecycle in the ledger test suite.

definition: Other account-level journal lines per account-year (fees, investment allocation)
rationale: Quarterly fee assessment (4x2) + rebalancing/unit movements (2x2). Pool-level NAV postings are not per account.
validation_method: Ledger posting counts per fund over a year.

definition: Total journal lines per account-year (derived)
source: = INF-VOL-001 x INF-LED-001 + INF-VOL-002 x INF-LED-002 + INF-LED-003

definition: Stored bytes per journal line including indexes and tuple overhead
source: PostgreSQL tuple header 23-24 B + ~160-250 B payload (4-6 UUIDs, amount, currency, bitemporal timestamps, tenant id) + 3-4 B-tree index entries at ~30-50 B each
rationale: Append-only rows never update, so no HOT/dead-tuple churn; indexes dominate the overhead.
validation_method: pg_total_relation_size / row count on a loaded test schema.

definition: Durable events/commands persisted per account-year (commands, outbox, process-manager, audit, notifications)
source: Unbound CNV-ARC-001 (outbox, durable process-manager rows, timer table); reasoning
rationale: ~10 rows per business transaction across command, outbox and audit tables, for ~13 transactions + logins, statements and notifications.
validation_method: Count rows written per scenario in Echelon.Execution integration tests.

definition: Stored bytes per event row (JSON payload + indexes)
rationale: JSONB payload 0.5-2 KB (TOAST-compressed above 2 KB) plus key/time indexes.

definition: Account master/reference data per account-year (parties, preferences, document metadata rows)
rationale: Includes object-storage metadata rows (hash, retention class, verdicts).
validation_method: Measure table sizes per fund in a test tenant.

definition: Database bytes added per account-year (derived)
source: = INF-LED-004 x INF-DB-001 + INF-DB-002 x INF-DB-003 + INF-DB-004
rationale: Base 84 x 0.4 + 150 x 1.5 + 20 = 278.6 KB. Event rows are ~80% of bytes.
validation_method: Measure growth per fund-year in a load test.

definition: Storage overhead factor (free space, WAL headroom, catalog, bloat)
rationale: Append-only workloads have little bloat; WAL and free-space headroom dominate.
validation_method: Compare provisioned vs logical size in staging.

definition: Years of history carried in the online database per active account (steady state, includes closed-account records kept for retention)
source: Unbound CNV-PLT-004 (10-year retention after transaction date)
rationale: Accounts vary in tenure; closed accounts keep records 10 years. High assumes no archival of old partitions out of the online database.

definition: Peak-day multiplier over average day (December year-end giving)
source: daf-landscape seasonal evidence; Unbound UNB-AVL December peak benchmark (RM-05)
rationale: DAF contributions and grants concentrate in December, especially the last two weeks.
validation_method: Daily transaction histogram from sponsor data.

definition: Share of a peak day's events in the peak hour
rationale: Business-hours concentration; batch statement runs scheduled off-peak.

definition: Database CPU per 1,000 durable events (write path incl. ledger, outbox, projections)
source: Unbound simplification-economics BENCH: 2,127-3,944 tx/s measured on 4 vCPU (~1-2 ms CPU per simple transaction); each event here is assumed 2-5x heavier
rationale: 4 vCPU-s per 1k events = 4 ms per event, i.e. ~250 events/s per fully used vCore. A 2-vCore server at 50% target utilisation with 2x read amplification handles ~125 events/s sustained.
validation_method: Benchmark RM-05 on the chosen managed PostgreSQL tier.

definition: Read amplification (queries, statement runs, projections) relative to write CPU
rationale: Statement generation and donor portal reads add CPU; cache-ready architecture limits it.
validation_method: pg_stat_statements share of CPU by query class.

definition: Target peak CPU utilisation for the primary
rationale: Headroom for failover warm-up, vacuum and incident load. Inverse driver: the cost-low case uses 0.6 and the cost-high case 0.4.

definition: DB I/O operations per 1,000 events (WAL fsync, heap and index page writes after group commit)
rationale: ~5 page writes per event after group commit. At base 1M accounts: peak 171 events/s x 5 = ~860 IOPS, inside a 1 TB+ Premium SSD's ~5,000 IOPS, so IOPS is not a separate cost driver.
validation_method: iostat / Azure Monitor IOPS during benchmark.

definition: Hot working set to keep in RAM (months of ledger/master data + 15% of event bytes)
rationale: Drives the memory rule: vCores >= hot set GB / 4 GB per vCore (Ddsv5/m7g). At base it never binds before CPU.
validation_method: Buffer cache hit ratio > 99% at load.

definition: Backup storage multiplier (PITR full + WAL retained) relative to database size
source: reasoning; Azure/AWS give free backup up to 100% of provisioned storage
rationale: 35-day PITR with weekly fulls; billable only above provisioned storage, which the model sizes at >=1.2x data, so base backup cost is ~0.

definition: Long-term logical backup copies retained in archive tier (12 monthly + 10 annual), compressed to 30% of DB size
source: Unbound UNB-ING-STO-005 (consistent restore of DB + objects); CNV-PLT-004
rationale: Separate from PITR. Archive tier makes it negligible (base 1M accounts: 2,438 GB x 0.3 x 22 x $0.00099 = $16/month).

definition: Generated documents per account-year (quarterly statements, annual summary, contribution acknowledgments, grant confirmations)
rationale: 4 statements + 1 annual + 3 acknowledgments + ~4 grant letters rendered as PDF (others are email-only).

definition: Size per generated document
rationale: Text PDFs with embedded subset fonts and a logo are typically 50-150 KB.

definition: Evidence-file storage per grant (attachments; most grants have none)
rationale: Average over all grants: ~10% carry a 300-500 KB attachment. High covers sponsors that require due-diligence files.

definition: PDF generation compute per document
rationale: Server-side HTML-to-PDF or programmatic PDF; 2 GiB-s memory per vCPU-s assumed.

definition: Retention of financial records and documents
source: Unbound CNV-PLT-004: transaction records 10 years after the transaction date (7 = IRS/general floor; 12 = conservative)
rationale: Requirement text sets 10 years; low/high bracket the policy.
validation_method: Sponsor compliance owner approval of the retention schedule.

definition: Application log volume per 1,000 durable events
rationale: ~10 structured log lines x ~1 KB per event; sampling of debug logs off in production.
validation_method: Log Analytics ingestion per event over a week.

definition: API/page requests per account-year
rationale: ~4 sessions x ~80 requests incl. static assets; API logs ~1 KB per request (low 0.3, high 3).

definition: Fixed platform log volume per month (health, platform, DB logs) per production environment
rationale: Filtered probes and audit of control plane.

definition: Years of application-log retention in archive tier
source: reasoning; financial audit evidence lives in the append-only DB, not logs
rationale: Analytics tier 31 days included; rest in $0.02/GB-month archive.

definition: Internet egress per account-year (WASM bundle cache misses, API, document downloads)
rationale: WebAssembly bundle 2-10 MB compressed, cached at the edge and in the browser; ~4 sessions a year.

definition: AI-assisted calls (exceptions and drafting) per account-year
rationale: Most work is deterministic; AI only on exceptions, document extraction and support drafts.
validation_method: Count AI calls per fund in pilot.

definition: Input tokens per AI-assisted exception
rationale: Case context, policy excerpt and evidence summary. Prompt caching (0.05x reads on Sonnet/Opus 5.5) can cut repeated policy text cost.

definition: Output tokens per AI-assisted exception (incl. thinking)
rationale: Structured recommendation; Opus 5.5 thinking cannot be disabled and is billed as output (high case).

definition: Cost per AI-assisted exception (derived)
source: low = Haiku 5.5 batch 3k/0.3k; base = Sonnet 5.5 8k/1k; high = Opus 5.5 30k/3k (ANT-001..006)

definition: Transactional emails per account-year
rationale: Receipts, grant confirmations, statement notices, security notices.

definition: Monthly active users as a share of accounts (users per account x monthly sign-in rate)
source: reasoning: base 1.3 users/account x 15% monthly sign-in
rationale: DAF donors sign in a few times a year; advisors/successors add users. Free tiers (Entra 50k MAU, Cognito 10k) cover small scales.

definition: SMS MFA messages per account-year
source: reasoning: logins/year (2/4/12) x share using SMS (0.1/0.3/0.7)
rationale: Passkeys/TOTP preferred; SMS kept as a fallback. Largest per-account infra line at scale with MAU.

definition: New accounts as a share of active accounts per year (drives identity and bank verification checks)
rationale: External verification APIs are charged per new account or change, not per account-year.

definition: Non-production environments cost as a share of production fixed infrastructure
rationale: Dev + test + staging on burstable DB, scale-to-zero apps, Front Door Standard; high = full prod-like staging plus per-sponsor sandboxes.

definition: CI usage per month beyond the plan allowance
rationale: Base = Team allowance-sized usage (3,000 Linux minutes) priced once; F# builds + tests ~10 min x ~300 runs/month.

definition: Application CPU per 1,000 events and per request
rationale: F# component monolith; minimum 2 replicas x 0.5 vCPU (1 vCPU each at 1M accounts) absorb load; bursts billed per second.

definition: Number of large sponsors on isolated databases (C3)
source: Unbound CNV-ARC-001 (dedicated database only when risk or contract requires)
rationale: Each isolated sponsor adds an HA primary + DR replica + key + scanning account.
